hold_text: Lane PAIRS-R-SCALE-FIX-1016 (Manager Session 2026-10-16): pairs order-path + sizing change, Tier 3 by path (src/units/strategies/**), HELD for the manager/operator to merge. why: PAIRS-R-SCALE: with hedge_beta rolling, risk = stop_z x std of the rolling-beta spread was inflated by beta drift (~87x on the planted fixture, ~775x measured on SOL/ETH 1h), so every Bybit pair leg was undersized and its exits were read on a drifting series.
